file.description: Unified master dataset combining clean market data, 85 engineered features, base targets, labels, dynamic thetas, and big move flags.

columns.name: open
columns.description: Candle open price in USDT (Binance kline field 2). First traded price in the 5-minute interval.

columns.name: high
columns.description: Highest traded price within the 5-minute candle (Binance kline field 3).

columns.name: low
columns.description: Lowest traded price within the 5-minute candle (Binance kline field 4).

columns.name: close
columns.description: Candle close price in USDT (Binance kline field 5). Last traded price in the 5-minute interval. Used as reference for all labels.

columns.name: volume
columns.description: Total traded volume in BTC (base asset) during the candle (Binance kline field 6).

columns.name: quote_volume
columns.description: Total traded volume in USDT (quote asset) during the candle (Binance kline field 8).
columns.formula: sum(price_i × qty_i) for all trades in candle

columns.name: number_of_trades
columns.description: Count of individual trades executed during the 5-minute candle (Binance kline field 9).

columns.name: taker_buy_base_volume
columns.description: Volume in BTC bought by taker orders during candle (Binance kline field 10).

columns.name: taker_buy_quote_volume
columns.description: Volume in USDT bought by taker orders during candle (Binance kline field 11).

columns.name: gap_id
columns.description: Contiguous segment identifier. Increments at every non-consecutive 5m gap. Rows with same gap_id form a continuous OHLCV segment.

columns.name: is_gap_boundary
columns.description: True if row is the first candle of a new contiguous segment.

columns.description: Forward close-to-close return over 2 candles (10 min).

columns.name: fwd_ret_open_2
columns.description: Conservative forward return for backtesting over 2 candles (10 min). Entry at open[t+1].

columns.name: raw_sign_2
columns.description: Raw directional sign of fwd_ret_2 (+1, -1, 0).

columns.name: has_valid_target_2
columns.description: True if row t has a valid forward label for horizon N=2 (no gap crossing, not in boundary).
columns.formula: gap_id[t] == gap_id[t+2] AND t not in last 2 rows

columns.name: target_2_S1
columns.description: 3-class label for horizon N=2 (10 min), rule S1 (+1 Up, -1 Down, 0 Neutral). Symmetric cost-floor threshold: theta_up = theta_down = c (0.23%).
columns.formula: Label rule S1 evaluated against forward return fwd_ret_2

columns.name: target_2_S2
columns.description: 3-class label for horizon N=2 (10 min), rule S2 (+1 Up, -1 Down, 0 Neutral). Symmetric fixed threshold: theta_up = theta_down = 0.30%.
columns.formula: Label rule S2 evaluated against forward return fwd_ret_2

columns.name: target_2_Q1
columns.description: 3-class label for horizon N=2 (10 min), rule Q1 (+1 Up, -1 Down, 0 Neutral). Symmetric quantile threshold: theta = max(c, median |ret|). Floor binds (Q1 == S1).
columns.formula: Label rule Q1 evaluated against forward return fwd_ret_2

columns.name: target_2_V1
columns.description: 3-class label for horizon N=2 (10 min), rule V1 (+1 Up, -1 Down, 0 Neutral). Volatility-adjusted threshold (half-sigma): theta = max(c, 0.5 * sigma * sqrt(N)).
columns.formula: Label rule V1 evaluated against forward return fwd_ret_2

columns.name: target_2_V2
columns.description: 3-class label for horizon N=2 (10 min), rule V2 (+1 Up, -1 Down, 0 Neutral). Volatility-adjusted threshold (one-sigma): theta = max(c, 1.0 * sigma * sqrt(N)).
columns.formula: Label rule V2 evaluated against forward return fwd_ret_2

columns.name: target_2_A1
columns.description: 3-class label for horizon N=2 (10 min), rule A1 (+1 Up, -1 Down, 0 Neutral). Asymmetric threshold: theta_up = 0.23%, theta_down = 0.30%.
columns.formula: Label rule A1 evaluated against forward return fwd_ret_2

columns.name: target_2_A2
columns.description: 3-class label for horizon N=2 (10 min), rule A2 (+1 Up, -1 Down, 0 Neutral). Asymmetric threshold: theta_up = 0.30%, theta_down = 0.23%.
columns.formula: Label rule A2 evaluated against forward return fwd_ret_2

columns.name: target_2_F05
columns.description: 3-class label for horizon N=2 (10 min), rule F05 (+1 Up, -1 Down, 0 Neutral). Research sub-cost threshold: theta_up = theta_down = 0.05% (move below cost c=0.23%; label is NOT tradable after costs; a signal on a move below c loses money).
columns.formula: Label rule F05 evaluated against forward return fwd_ret_2

columns.name: target_2_F10
columns.description: 3-class label for horizon N=2 (10 min), rule F10 (+1 Up, -1 Down, 0 Neutral). Research sub-cost threshold: theta_up = theta_down = 0.10% (move below cost c=0.23%; label is NOT tradable after costs; a signal on a move below c loses money).
